subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only the
stimulus: corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 1 x 8 = 8 (a) On the way, people were showing due respect to the statue of the goddess. (b) So, feeling proud, the donkey started to bray in joy. (c) Once a statue of goddess was being taken to the town placing on the back of a donkey. (d) Then the driver of the donkey became very angry. (e) Saying this, he started beating the donkey with his stick. (f) Seeing this, the donkey thought that people were showing him honour. (g) He said, "you wretched, do you think people show you this respect? Such a bad day for man will never come." (h) Moreover, it refused to move even a step. Part-B : Writing Test [50 Marks]
guide_solution: b d c f h g a e Napoleon, the king of France, was a great hero. He won many battles and conquered many countries of Europe. One day he was walking along the sea-shore. Suddenly. he noticed a wonderful thing. An English boy was making a small boat. The boy was brought before him. The king asked him why he was making such a small boat. The boy said, "I shall cross the sea and go to my home."
